title: Assessing the Highs and Lows of Operation Inherent Resolve
gist: After 12 years of US military force against the Islamic State in Iraq and Syria, the United States has concluded Operation Inherent Resolve. Victoria Taylor assesses its successes, unfinished business, and what the end means for future US security cooperation with Iraq and Syria. (Podcast episode notes only.)
